# desigrs.monster

> Premium domain name offered for sale directly by its owner.

desigrs.monster is a brandable, seven-letter, one-word domain in the .monster generic
top-level domain. It is listed for sale at an asking price of 6,500 USD and is suitable for
AI design tools, generative design platforms, creative studios, and design-led brands.

The sale is executed owner-to-buyer through Escrow.com. There is no website, traffic history,
or email service included — this is a name-only acquisition.

## Key facts

- Domain: desigrs.monster
- Status: available for acquisition
- Asking price: 6,500 USD
- Length: 7 letters, one word
- Extension: .monster (ICANN gTLD)
- Contact: sales@desertrich.com
- Transfer: escrow-secured, typically under 24 hours for a same-registrar push
